Wikipedia (fetched 2026-10-29): founded 1970 in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, first as a store called Free People; renamed Urban Outfitters and incorporated in 1976. Founders Richard Hayne, Judy Wicks and Scott Belair. Headquarters Philadelphia. Owned by the public company Urban Outfitters, Inc. (Nasdaq: URBN), whose other brands include Anthropologie, Free People, Terrain, BHLDN and the Vetri Family restaurant group.

Wikipedia: the Urban Outfitters store sells women's and men's apparel, footwear, beauty and wellness, accessories, activewear, housewares and music (mainly vinyl records and cassettes); much of the merchandise is designed and produced by the company's wholesale division under multiple private labels (not named on the page).
